name: github-profile-orbit
description: A high-quality GitHub Action that generates beautiful, data-driven vector visualizations (SVG) of your GitHub ecosystem for your profile README.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/browser.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=js/orbit-renderer.js
scripts.build:cli: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/cli.js

author: NiconiKimg
